channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — free-for-dev
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Groundmail — via free-for-dev
item.description: Transactional email API and SMTP relay. 3,000 emails/month free (100/day), three domains, three agent mailboxes, inbound email included.

item.title: Beliq — via free-for-dev
item.description: European REST API platform for e-invoicing, including generating, validating and delivering e-invoices. The free plan includes 20 live documents/month, plus 400 sandbox documents/month (no card required).

item.title: Spreelytics — via free-for-dev
item.description: Privacy first website and product analytics SaaS that can trace your revenue sources. Free plan: 1 million events per month, unlimited projects and team members with most of the needed features like dashboard, goal, funnel, ai crawler, revenue, and much more.

item.title: Rizamo — via free-for-dev
item.description: Social media publishing API: schedule and publish to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, YouTube and more over REST, webhooks or an MCP server for AI agents, with comment inbox and analytics. Free forever for 2 connected accounts, unlimited posts, every feature included, no credit card.

item.title: RudderStack — via free-for-dev
item.description: Event streaming to 200+ destinations and data warehouse, plus reverse ETL. Comes with MCP server and CLI for AI agents. Free forever for 250k events/month.

item.title: Reliant — via free-for-dev
item.description: Host, monitor, and deploy your services with production best practices. Tracing, continuous profiling, metrics, and logs fully baked in and correlated with each release allow you to identify and auto rollback on demand. One free static site per organization, 1 GiB of storage, 10 GiB of traffic a month, CDN with HTTPS, custom domains, no card needed, deployed with the open-source forge CLI.

item.title: GravEx Chat — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free chat sdk that works for any client, like web, Android, iOS or whatever. Create API key and hand it over to your own Agent(Claude, Codex...) with llms.txt, then you get your messenger to your service. It's that simple.

item.title: measure.sh — via free-for-dev
item.description: Mobile app monitoring with errors, performance tracking and session replays. 5 GB data per month free. No limits if self-hosted.

item.title: notifysphere.net — via free-for-dev
item.description: All-in-one Customer Engagement and Automation Tool ( push notifications, whatsapp messages, helpdesk, tracker link and events tracking) for SaaS. Free for up to 1,000 active users per month.

item.title: DNSvivo — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free managed DNS with automatic failover, weighted load balancing, and Dynamic DNS (DDNS). Includes 2 domains, 5 IP addresses monitored from 5 locations, and 3 DDNS records.

item.title: staticforms.dev — via free-for-dev
item.description: Integrate HTML forms easily without any server-side code for free. After the user submits the form, an email with the form content will be sent to your registered address.

item.title: nosocial Embed API — via free-for-dev
item.description: A free API for developers to embed public posts from X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, Threads, Facebook, Telegram, Reddit, and LinkedIn on their websites. It returns the embed HTML and any required scripts as JSON. No API key and no request limits.

item.title: InstaBox — via free-for-dev
item.description: Cloud Linux machine for AI agents and developers, running on Firecracker microVMs with Docker and common toolchains preinstalled. Free plan: one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine, 20 GiB disk, 5 snapshots and 100 GiB egress per month, no credit card required. Not a persistent VPS: a free machine pauses after 30 minutes idle and runs at most 8 hours per session.

item.title: Uppcoder — via free-for-dev
item.description: Full stack development environment hosted on own infrastructure with selectable framework, db engine behind https with ssh access, vscode + terminal in the editor. Free tier: always on, 2GB disk and 2GB ram. No card required.

item.title: BillDog.io — via free-for-dev
item.description: In-app subscription paywalls, A/B testing, product analytics, and messaging with SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Unity, and web. Free up to $3k/mo in tracked revenue and 1M monthly analytics events.

item.title: Topscan.me — via free-for-dev
item.description: SaaS vulnerability scanning platform. Free: a full infrastructure scan of one host every week, Discovery and Attack Surface for everything around it, one repository, one user, findings with a fix and a Security Score.

item.title: Canjean — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free exchange rate API for 150+ currencies in JSON, CSV and plain text, no API key or sign-up.

item.title: hypermonitors.com — via free-for-dev
item.description: Monitors your infrastructure from three different locations (ZH - NYC - SG) with every outage checked from a 2nd location before alerts go out. Free forever for 5 monitors and 5 minute checks.

item.title: evalship — via free-for-dev
item.description: find the flaws in your LLM evals. Reviews your evals suite for improvement opportunities, monitors your PRs for any eval regressions or unintended side effects and optimizes your prompts and models based on experiments in your product. Free for 1 private repo for 1 user, 100 PR analyses a month, 30 days of eval history. Free for public repos.

item.title: CyberShield Studio — via free-for-dev
item.description: Security monitoring for e-commerce store operators and developers. Weekly scans for JavaScript changes or injection, tracking before consent, security header settings, and vulnerable client-side libraries and WordPress plugins. Free plan monitors 1 store (home page + checkout path) with 30 days of history. No credit card required.

item.title: whatayarn — via free-for-dev
item.description: Online form builder. Unlimited forms and responses on Free, subject to fair use.

item.title: UserJot — via free-for-dev
item.description: Live chat, feedback boards, a roadmap, and a changelog, so everything your customers say reaches the people and agents building your product. Free plan: Unlimited Posts, Unlimited Users, 3 Admin Roles, 2 Feedback Boards, Roadmap, Changelog.

item.title: UsageRail — via free-for-dev
item.description: API keys, rate limits, quotas and usage-based billing for paid APIs, checked inside your own server with no gateway. Free up to $1,000/month billed and 1M requests/month.

item.title: TimeLogic API — via free-for-dev
item.description: World time and timezone API with cryptographically signed JSON responses, so you can verify the time wasn't tampered with. Get the current time by timezone, IP address or coordinates, convert between zones, check DST changes, and do business-day date math. WorldTimeAPI-compatible endpoints for apps that used worldtimeapi.org. Free plan includes 10,000 requests/month on all endpoints.

item.title: Pug — via free-for-dev
item.description: Open-source product analytics with autocapture, trends, funnels, retention, user flows and unified user profiles. Free plan includes 100,000 events per month and 1 year of data retention.

item.title: Gairė — via free-for-dev
item.description: Web Change monitoring for research, price changes, out-of/in stock monitoring. Free plan up to 10 pages checked every hour, alerts by sms, email, Webhook, Slack/Discord/Telegram integrations. No card needed.

item.title: EthioDeploy — via free-for-dev
item.description: Hosting and agentic coding platform containing Built-in Analytics, Database, GitHub CI/CD, free sub-domain, CLI, AI coding agent. Free tier allows one project 256 MB RAM / 0.5 CPU, sleeps after 30 min idle, 512 MB database and 100,000 tokens on the default model one time.

item.title: Archboard — via free-for-dev
item.description: Architecture diagrams your team and AI agents edit live. Free plan: 1 seat, 3 diagrams, all built-in node packs and live editing with your AI agents (MCP).

item.title: Shotlane — via free-for-dev
item.description: Screenshots, clean Markdown and PDFs of any web page, rendered in current Chrome. Hide cookie banners, ads and other popups and many more options. A free account gives you 100 credits per month, no card required.

item.title: RealUptime Errors — via free-for-dev
item.description: Error tracking that works with Sentry SDKs. Free for 10,000 events a month with 14-day retention; past the cap, events are refused and counted, never billed.

item.title: RealUptime — via free-for-dev
item.description: Uptime checks from 4 regions every 3 minutes, a public status page with 100 subscribers, and API, CLI, Terraform and MCP access. Free for 10 monitors, commercial use allowed, no card required.

item.title: Datasense — via free-for-dev
item.description: Web analytics with JavaScript error tracking, goals, and revenue attribution. Free plan: 1 site, 5,000 events per month.

item.title: mxRaven — via free-for-dev
item.description: Programmable inbound email infrastructure with webhook, forward, and auto-reply routing, plus a durable pull-based event stream for consuming mail without a public endpoint. Free tier includes 1,000 outbound and 1,000 inbound tasks per month, 1 workspace, and 1 domain.

item.title: PingWise — via free-for-dev
item.description: Quorum-based uptime monitoring, using 15 probes in 6 different continents. Pricing is credit based, offering 650,000 free checks per month (translates to 75 free monitors at 5-minute checks). No credit card, unlimited users.

item.title: DocSpring — via free-for-dev
item.description: Fill out PDF forms, generate PDFs and Word documents, and collect e-signatures. Free developer plan includes unlimited test PDFs and 10 filled PDFs per month. Up to 10 templates, 2 users, and 2 integrations. No credit card required and no time limits.

item.title: CertAvert — via free-for-dev
item.description: Monitor SSL/TLS certificates on any port, checks expiry, chain problems, revocation, host mismatch. Monitor 15 domains free, get expiry notifications, email, Slack or Discord. No credit card required for signup.

item.title: pkgscan.dev — via free-for-dev
item.description: Multi-engine supply chain scanner for npm, PyPI, VS Code extensions, Cargo, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Go and AI agent skills. Checks for malware and known vulnerabilities, including hash lookups that need no upload. Free tier: 5 scans per month with full findings.

item.title: Featureflip — via free-for-dev
item.description: Featureflip is a full featured feature flag platform that removes its own dead flags by submitting its own pull requests. Free plan includes 10 flags, 2 environments, 1 project, 3 users, and no usage caps.

item.title: VaelMail — via free-for-dev
item.description: Privacy-first webmail with deterministic 16-digit account keys and zero phone verification. Free tier includes 50 MB receive-only mailbox storage, unlimited subaddressing, and persistent @vael.pw aliases with no credit card required.

item.title: UserNote — via free-for-dev
item.description: A user feedback tool to capture most wanted features, free supports up to 50 feature ideas and unlimited votes.

item.title: Keeper.sh — via free-for-dev
item.description: A calendar syncing tool that keeps your work, personal, business or student calendars in sync. Free for up to 2 calendars, 3 connections, and give your agent or scripts access to read and modify your calendars with up to 25 calls per day.

item.title: logoapi.sh — via free-for-dev
item.description: Company logo API with no key or signup, the ideal Clearbit logo API alternative with SVG logos for any domain. 1M free requests a month per site.

item.title: eForward — via free-for-dev
item.description: Email forwarding for custom domains. Free plan includes 1 domain, 1 mailbox, 10 aliases (catch-all ones count too), catch-all, and reply/send from your aliases (up to 5 new recipients a day). No credit card required.

item.title: PolyDoc — via free-for-dev
item.description: REST API for HTML to PDF and screenshot generation. Including templates, PDF/A and PDF/UA output, privacy-focused, and more features. The free plan includes 150 conversions/month.

item.title: FrostyVerify — via free-for-dev
item.description: Email verification, usable through a web app, a REST API and an MCP server + 1,000 Free Email verifications a month, no card

item.title: Formlane — via free-for-dev
item.description: Formlane is a form backend for static websites, site builders or AI-built apps. One endpoint gets email notifications with reply-to, spam-filtering without captcha and a CSV export. All submissions are stored in Frankfurt. Free Plan: 250 submissions/mo, no trial.

item.title: AliasMail — via free-for-dev
item.description: Privacy-preserving email forwarding and alias service with HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks and custom alias handles. Free tier includes permanent email forwarding, custom aliases, and webhook integrations with no credit card required.

item.title: WishKit — via free-for-dev
item.description: In-app feature request and feedback board for iOS and web apps where users submit and vote on features. Free forever plan with no card: 1 project, iOS and web SDKs, unlimited users, shows the first 5 feature requests.

item.title: Nisuform — via free-for-dev
item.description: Simple, Easy and Secure form backend for any websites with beautiful form template and intuitive form builder. AI ready with MCP. Free plan includes 100 free submissions, spam protection and turnstile.

item.title: BootForm — via free-for-dev
item.description: Form backend for builders. Free plan: 250 submissions a month with unlimited forms. Email and Discord notifications, honeypot/CAPTCHA, and an MCP server so AI coding agents can create and configure forms and manage submissions.
